name: consultly-call-widget
description: Standalone script the Shopify Theme Extension loads to open the customer-side call modal directly on the storefront page, with no iframe and no page navigation. Reuses the React app's own Agora call engine (callSlice.js), Socket.IO singleton (SokectConfig.js), and ringtone helper (ringingTune.js) by importing those exact files from ../consultly_Frontend — same engine, not a second implementation.
